candidates.label: A
candidates.notes: Body text is accurate, but furigana (さとう) is added to the second 佐藤 in the example quote, where the image has none. The underline on the example answer べきです is not marked. Circled numbers are kept.

candidates.label: B
candidates.notes: All text and furigana are correct. 睡眠不足 furigana is split into 睡眠(すいみん)不足(ぶそく), which is acceptable. The leading space inside the choice parentheses is dropped, and the underline on the example answer is missing.

candidates.label: C
candidates.notes: All text and furigana are correct and placed as in the image. The boxed 例 is rendered in bold, a reasonable equivalent. Spacing and circled numbers are preserved. The underline on the example answer べきです is missing.

candidates.label: D
candidates.notes: Invents furigana 体(から) in item ③; the image has no furigana on 体, and the reading given is also wrong (it would be からだ). The rest is accurate. The underline on the example answer is missing.

candidates.label: E
candidates.notes: Text and furigana are accurate. The circled numbers ①②③ are converted to a markdown ordered list 1. 2. 3., and a ## header is added. The underline on the example answer is missing.

rationale: All five transcribe the body text correctly and all omit the underline on the example answer, so the ranking turns on smaller differences. C and B are both faithful, with C slightly ahead for preserving spacing and marking the boxed 例. E is textually accurate but replaces the circled numbers with a markdown list. A adds furigana that is not in the image on the second 佐藤, and D is last because its invented furigana 体(から) is also an incorrect reading.
